_about: A kit sheet for the formula estimate (math-fallback P2, `app/formula/genshin/sheets.py`). Structure (which number buffs what, for whom, under which condition) is transcribed from Genshin Optimizer's character sheets at `go_commit` (MIT), cited per effect to `pando:`/`wr:` file:lines under the `go` roots, and to gcsim's Go at `gcsim_commit` where gcsim implements the same buff. No number is written here: every value is a reference into the seeded catalogue (a talent row by label, a constellation or passive param_list by index), pinned under `pins` so a re-seed that changes one withholds the effect rather than misreading it.

conditions.label: Crystal Shrapnel consumed by the shot, the first three
Crystal Shrapnel consumed beyond three (up to six)

effects.label: A1 Undisclosed Distribution Channels: Normal, Charged and Plunging Attack DMG
A4 Mutual Assistance Network: ATK with one Pyro, Electro, Cryo or Hydro member
A4 Mutual Assistance Network: ATK again with a second such member
Ceremonial Crystalshot: Skill DMG per Crystal Shrapnel beyond three

value.cite: GO pando:Navia.ts:51-53,111-115 `skillParam_gen.skill[1][0]`, a parameter no seeded row label names (the seeded skill row's param2); gcsim skill.go:242 `0.15 * excess`

C6 The Flexible Finesse of the Spina's President: Skill CRIT DMG per Crystal Shrapnel beyond three
